title: Vitexin and Isovitexin Act through Inhibition of Insulin Receptor to Promote Longevity and Fitness in Caenorhabditis elegans.
authors: Tao, Mingfang; Li, Rong; Zhang, Zhuo; Wu, Ting; Xu, Tingting; Zogona, Daniel; Huang, Yuting; Pan, Siyi; Xu, Xiaoyun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化合物通过抑制胰岛素受体延长线虫寿命，虽含分子对接但对象为受体-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: SCOPE: Vitexin and isovitexin are natural plant nutraceuticals for human health and longevity. This research investigates the underlying mechanisms of vitexin and isovitexin on aging and health. The vital role of DAF-2/insulin-like growth factor-1 receptor (IGFR) is illustrated in the insulin/insulin-like growth signaling pathway (IIS) modulated by vitexin and isovitexin. METHODS AND RESULTS: In vitro, in vivo models and molecular docking methods are performed to explore the antiaging mechanism of vitexin and isovitexin. Vitexin and isovitexin (50 and 100 microM) extended the lifespan of Caenorhabditis elegans. The declines of pharyngeal pumping and body bending rates, and the increase of intestinal lipofuscin accumulation, three markers of aging, are postponed by these compounds. They inhibit IIS pathway in a daf-16-dependent manner, subsequently increasing the expressions of DAF-16 downstream protein and gene in nematodes. Molecular docking studies demonstrate that these compounds mightinhibit insulin signal by binding to the crucial amino acid residue ARG1003 in the pocket of IGFR. Western blot indicates that IGFR, PI3K, and AKT kinase expressions in senescent cells are decreased after vitexin and isovitexin treatment. CONCLUSION: Vitexin and isovitexin may inhibit IIS pathway by occupying adenosine-triphosphate binding site pocket of IGFR, subsequently decreasing IGFR expression, thereby promoting longevity and fitness.
abstract_zh: 范围：牡荆素（vitexin）和异牡荆素（isovitexin）是天然植物营养素，有益于人类健康与长寿。本研究探讨了牡荆素和异牡荆素对衰老及健康的作用机制。在胰岛素/胰岛素样生长信号通路（IIS）中，DAF-2/胰岛素样生长因子-1受体（IGFR）的关键作用被阐明，该通路受牡荆素和异牡荆素调节。方法与结果：采用体外、体内模型及分子对接方法，探索牡荆素和异牡荆素的抗衰老机制。牡荆素和异牡荆素（50和100微摩尔）延长了秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）的寿命。咽部泵送率和身体弯曲率的下降，以及肠道脂褐素积累的增加（这三个衰老标志）被这些化合物延缓。它们以daf-16依赖性方式抑制IIS通路，随后增加线虫中DAF-16下游蛋白和基因的表达。分子对接研究表明，这些化合物可能通过结合IGFR口袋中的关键氨基酸残基ARG1003来抑制胰岛素信号。Western blot显示，经牡荆素和异牡荆素处理后，衰老细胞中IGFR、PI3K和AKT激酶的表达降低。结论：牡荆素和异牡荆素可能通过占据IGFR的三磷酸腺苷结合位点口袋来抑制IIS通路，随后降低IGFR表达，从而促进长寿和健康。
